scope: Primary documentation and publication discovery only. Registration does not admit a data artifact, verify coverage, authorize acquisition, establish target-market validity or authorize trading.

evidence_grade_definitions.A: Official raw data, law or regulation, formal technical standard, official public database, original experiment, or high-quality peer-reviewed research.
evidence_grade_definitions.B: Authoritative institution report, professional database, core industry data, or a research report with reproducible methods and sources.
evidence_grade_definitions.C: Secondary research or professional analysis with explicit methods, samples and upstream sources.
evidence_grade_definitions.D: News retelling, platform article, personal experience, forum material, or a conclusion without a fully disclosed method.
evidence_grade_definitions.E: Untraceable, unreproducible or materially subjective assertion.

global_admission_rule: Authority grade, file integrity, coverage, revision and point-in-time status are independent. An A-grade publisher can still have UNKNOWN or GAP status. No source is research-data eligible until the exact artifact, instrument, field, window, license, clock, revision and adapter contract pass later gates.
